payload.words: The statechart tool reads a rule's source as a reference to one Goal's line or one guard of hyp spec, and an over-budget check says it predicts nothing.

lines.text: goal.md counts a line of the Goal as named only by a rule whose source names that Goal and that line; a source G-OTHER:line-1 names no line of this Goal.
The tool reports each rule whose source is neither a list of G-XXXX:line-N nor hyp spec, guard NAME, names the rule, and exits 3.
When the model has more states than the chart budget, goal.md shows no variant as separated by none, and lists every example to try on the patch of every variant.
A model within the chart budget, whose rules have sources of both forms, gives the same goal.md as today.

why: #444 goal D: rule sources are free text, and an over-budget check reads as separated by none
